route.ask: Which one does the request ask for?

bank.what:
Pull a month's bank transactions.
Every debit and credit on the business account, and its balance on the month's last day.
not_for: matching the bank against the books
moving money or paying a bill
examples: pull the bank transactions for september
get august's bank feed
what went through the bank in october
bank statement for september
every payment in or out of the bank in august
show me the bank account for august
what went through the business account in august

invoices.what:
List a month's invoices.
What was billed to customers that month, and which invoices are paid.
not_for: sending, creating or chasing an invoice
money that came into the bank
examples: list september's invoices
which invoices went out in august
invoices for october
how many of september's invoices are paid
what did we bill customers in august
which invoices of october are still unpaid

cards.what:
List a month's company card expenses.
Every charge on the company cards, and which of them lack a receipt.
not_for: freezing a card or ordering a new one
examples: card expenses for september
what did we spend on cards in august
pull the october card charges
which card charges in september have no receipt
company card spend for october
what was charged on the company cards in august
company card charges for october

payroll.what:
Show a month's payroll run.
The salaries, taxes and total of a run already made. It pays no one.
not_for: adding someone to payroll or changing a salary
examples: show september's payroll
what did payroll cost in august
payroll breakdown for october
payroll taxes for september
how much was payroll in october
how much did the salaries cost in august

reconcile.what:
Reconcile a month's bank transactions with its invoices, card expenses and payroll.
It works on what was pulled just before it and lists what is left to review. It marks nothing.
not_for: closing the month in the ledger
examples: reconcile them
reconcile the books
match everything up
match them against the bank
reconcile the four

ledger.what:
Post a month's closing entries to the ledger.
Only the closing entries, in the ledger. A posted month can be reopened and its entries reversed.
not_for: looking up the ledger or its balances
posting a message in a chat channel
examples: post september to the ledger
book the october entries
post the closing entries for september
post october's entries to the general ledger
write october's closing to the ledger

send.what:
Email the month's closing report.
Only the closing report, to the one address you type; once sent it cannot be taken back.
not_for: sending an invoice to a customer
sharing the report in a chat channel
emailing a statement or a payslip
examples: send the report to cfo@example.com
email the month-end pack to omar@example.com
mail the month's report to board@example.com
get the closing report over to finance@example.com
the closing report goes to board@example.org
